title: Hospital Staff Circle
description: Five healthcare professionals at a Boston hospital connected through department work, carpooling, lunch routines, and volunteer activities. Rich in professional details, personal backgrounds, and shared experiences.

people.name: Priya Chandrasekaran
people.profile: Focused and decisive trauma surgeon. Born in Chennai, India, trained at Johns Hopkins. Carpools with Tomás and works closely with Elaine in the OR.

observations.text: Priya Chandrasekaran is a trauma surgeon at Massachusetts General Hospital and has been on staff since 2019.
Priya Chandrasekaran grew up in Chennai, India, and moved to the US at age 18 to attend the University of Michigan.
Priya Chandrasekaran and Tomás Herrera carpool together from Brookline every weekday in Priya's silver 2022 Volvo XC60.
Priya Chandrasekaran and Elaine Whitfield work together in the trauma OR and co-managed 47 emergency cases in the first quarter of 2024.
Priya Chandrasekaran completed her surgical residency at Johns Hopkins Hospital in Baltimore in 2018.
Priya Chandrasekaran published a paper on minimally invasive trauma techniques in the Journal of Trauma and Acute Care Surgery in March 2024.
Priya Chandrasekaran speaks English, Tamil, and Hindi fluently.
Priya Chandrasekaran's husband, Arjun, is a software engineer at Wayfair's Boston headquarters.
Priya Chandrasekaran has twin daughters, Meera and Kavya, who are 6 years old and attend Brookline public schools.
Priya Chandrasekaran performed a 9-hour emergency surgery to save a car accident victim on New Year's Day 2024.
Priya Chandrasekaran jogs along the Charles River Esplanade every morning at 5:15 AM before her hospital shift.
Priya Chandrasekaran is training for the Boston Marathon in April 2025, her first marathon.
Priya Chandrasekaran's mother, Dr. Lakshmi Chandrasekaran, is a cardiologist at Apollo Hospital in Chennai.
Priya Chandrasekaran volunteers with Nate Calloway at the Boston Health Care for the Homeless Program on the second Saturday of each month.
Priya Chandrasekaran won the Mass General Physician Excellence Award in June 2024.
Priya Chandrasekaran's favorite restaurant in Boston is Tatte Bakery & Cafe on Charles Street for their shakshuka.
Priya Chandrasekaran mentors two surgical residents and holds office hours on Wednesday afternoons.
Priya Chandrasekaran traveled to Chennai with her family for Diwali in November 2023.
Priya Chandrasekaran organized a trauma surgery simulation workshop for 30 medical students in February 2024.
Priya Chandrasekaran reads medical journals for exactly one hour every night before bed.

people.name: Elaine Whitfield
people.profile: Experienced trauma nurse from rural Vermont. Works alongside Priya in the OR and eats lunch regularly with Marcus. Calm under extreme pressure.

observations.text: Elaine Whitfield is a trauma nurse at Massachusetts General Hospital and has worked there for 8 years.
Elaine Whitfield grew up on a dairy farm in Stowe, Vermont.
Elaine Whitfield and Priya Chandrasekaran work together in the trauma OR and co-managed 47 emergency cases in the first quarter of 2024.
Elaine Whitfield and Marcus Chen eat lunch together every day at 12:30 PM in the hospital's third-floor cafeteria.
Elaine Whitfield earned her BSN from the University of Vermont in 2014 and her trauma nursing certification (TCRN) in 2017.
Elaine Whitfield delivered emergency roadside first aid to a cyclist hit by a car on Commonwealth Avenue in April 2024.
Elaine Whitfield's partner, Jess, is a high school biology teacher at Boston Latin School.
Elaine Whitfield lives in a two-bedroom apartment in Jamaica Plain with Jess and their dog, Moose, a Bernese Mountain Dog.
Elaine Whitfield teaches a CPR certification course at the hospital on the first Monday of every month.
Elaine Whitfield completed the Tough Mudder obstacle course in Western Massachusetts in September 2023.
Elaine Whitfield brews her own craft beer and won a blue ribbon for her oatmeal stout at the Jamaica Plain homebrew competition in October 2023.
Elaine Whitfield drives a red 2020 Jeep Wrangler.
Elaine Whitfield's father, Wayne Whitfield, still operates the family dairy farm in Stowe with 85 Holstein cows.
Elaine Whitfield ice-climbs every winter and summited Mount Washington via Huntington Ravine in January 2024.
Elaine Whitfield is studying for her nurse practitioner certification, with exams scheduled for December 2024.
Elaine Whitfield volunteers with Nate Calloway at the Boston Health Care for the Homeless Program on the second Saturday of each month.
Elaine Whitfield's favorite restaurant in Boston is El Pelon Taqueria on Peterborough Street.
Elaine Whitfield organized a hospital staff blood drive in March 2024 that collected 145 units.
Elaine Whitfield cross-country skis on the Stowe recreation path every time she visits her parents.
Elaine Whitfield was promoted to charge nurse of the trauma unit in July 2024.

people.name: Marcus Chen
people.profile: Detail-oriented pharmacist from San Francisco. Lunch buddy with Elaine, carpools with Tomás on days Priya is off. Meticulous and quiet.

observations.text: Marcus Chen is a clinical pharmacist at Massachusetts General Hospital, specializing in critical care medications.
Marcus Chen grew up in San Francisco's Sunset District and attended Lowell High School.
Marcus Chen and Elaine Whitfield eat lunch together every day at 12:30 PM in the hospital's third-floor cafeteria.
Marcus Chen and Tomás Herrera carpool together on Wednesdays and Fridays when Priya has her day off.
Marcus Chen earned his Doctor of Pharmacy degree from UCSF School of Pharmacy in 2019.
Marcus Chen caught a potentially fatal drug interaction between two prescriptions for an ICU patient in May 2024, preventing a medical error.
Marcus Chen plays competitive chess and is rated 1850 on chess.com.
Marcus Chen lives alone in a one-bedroom apartment in Cambridge, a 10-minute walk from Harvard Square.
Marcus Chen's parents, Wei and Linda Chen, own a dim sum restaurant called Jade Garden in San Francisco's Richmond District.
Marcus Chen completed a research study on antibiotic stewardship that was presented at the ASHP Midyear Conference in December 2023.
Marcus Chen practices tai chi in Harvard Yard every morning at 6 AM.
Marcus Chen is learning to play piano and takes lessons every Sunday at the New England Conservatory's continuing education program.
Marcus Chen bakes sourdough bread every weekend and maintains a 3-year-old starter he named 'Dough Fieri'.
Marcus Chen speaks English and Cantonese fluently and is learning Mandarin.
Marcus Chen ran the Boston 10K in June 2024 with a time of 48 minutes and 12 seconds.
Marcus Chen is training Nate Calloway's social work interns on medication literacy as part of a new hospital initiative.
Marcus Chen rides a blue Brompton folding bike to the hospital on days he doesn't carpool.
Marcus Chen visited Tokyo for two weeks in August 2023 and took a sushi-making course at the Tsukiji Cooking School.
Marcus Chen's favorite restaurant in Boston is Myers + Chang on Washington Street.
Marcus Chen won the hospital's Employee of the Quarter award in Q2 2024 for his antibiotic stewardship work.

people.name: Tomás Herrera
people.profile: Athletic and empathetic physical therapist from Miami. Carpools with Priya and Marcus, volunteers with Nate at community events.

observations.text: Tomás Herrera is a physical therapist in the rehabilitation department at Massachusetts General Hospital.
Tomás Herrera grew up in Miami, Florida, and his family is originally from Bogotá, Colombia.
Tomás Herrera and Priya Chandrasekaran carpool together from Brookline every weekday in Priya's silver 2022 Volvo XC60.
Tomás Herrera and Nate Calloway co-lead a weekly support group for patients recovering from orthopedic surgery every Tuesday afternoon.
Tomás Herrera earned his Doctor of Physical Therapy degree from the University of Miami in 2021.
Tomás Herrera helped a stroke patient named Mr. Kowalski regain the ability to walk independently after 14 weeks of intensive therapy in spring 2024.
Tomás Herrera speaks English and Spanish fluently.
Tomás Herrera plays on the hospital's co-ed soccer team, the Mass General Strikers, as a midfielder.
Tomás Herrera lives in a one-bedroom apartment in Brookline, three blocks from Priya's house on Beacon Street.
Tomás Herrera's mother, Carmen Herrera, is a nurse at Jackson Memorial Hospital in Miami.
Tomás Herrera completed a half-Ironman triathlon in Providence, Rhode Island in August 2023 with a time of 5 hours 42 minutes.
Tomás Herrera taught a free community yoga class at the Boston Common Frog Pond every Sunday morning from May through September 2024.
Tomás Herrera is certified in dry needling and completed his certification at the Kinetacore Institute in Atlanta in 2022.
Tomás Herrera and Marcus Chen carpool together on Wednesdays and Fridays when Priya has her day off.
Tomás Herrera adopted a rescue greyhound named Bolt from the Greyhound Friends of New England shelter.
Tomás Herrera is studying for the Orthopedic Clinical Specialist certification exam scheduled for February 2025.
Tomás Herrera's favorite restaurant in Boston is Taqueria El Barrio in East Boston.
Tomás Herrera flew home to Miami for his parents' 35th wedding anniversary celebration in January 2024.
Tomás Herrera presented a poster on aquatic therapy outcomes at the American Physical Therapy Association conference in San Antonio in June 2024.
Tomás Herrera coaches a youth soccer team called the Brookline Bobcats on Saturday mornings.

people.name: Nate Calloway
people.profile: Compassionate social worker from Baltimore who connects patients with community resources. Co-leads a support group with Tomás, volunteers with Priya and Elaine.

observations.text: Nate Calloway is a clinical social worker at Massachusetts General Hospital, assigned to the trauma and rehabilitation departments.
Nate Calloway grew up in Baltimore, Maryland, in the Hampden neighborhood.
Nate Calloway and Tomás Herrera co-lead a weekly support group for patients recovering from orthopedic surgery every Tuesday afternoon.
Nate Calloway volunteers with Priya Chandrasekaran and Elaine Whitfield at the Boston Health Care for the Homeless Program on the second Saturday of each month.
Nate Calloway earned his MSW from Boston University in 2015.
Nate Calloway successfully connected a homeless veteran named James with permanent housing and VA benefits in February 2024 after 6 months of case work.
Nate Calloway's wife, Rachel, is a librarian at the Boston Public Library's Copley Square branch.
Nate Calloway has a 3-year-old son named Owen and a 5-year-old daughter named Lily.
Nate Calloway lives in a three-bedroom house in Somerville, a 15-minute bike ride from the hospital.
Nate Calloway plays acoustic guitar and performs at the hospital's annual talent show every December.
Nate Calloway is training social work interns on medication literacy with Marcus Chen as part of a new hospital initiative.
Nate Calloway completed a 200-hour meditation teacher training at the Insight Meditation Society in Barre, Massachusetts in 2022.
Nate Calloway organized a hospital-wide mental health awareness week in May 2024 featuring 8 guest speakers.
Nate Calloway wrote a grant proposal that secured $45,000 from the Robert Wood Johnson Foundation for a patient navigation program in April 2024.
Nate Calloway's father, Earl Calloway, is a retired Baltimore City firefighter.
Nate Calloway bikes to work on a black Cannondale Quick 3 hybrid bike.
Nate Calloway leads a mindfulness meditation session for hospital staff every Friday at noon in the chapel.
Nate Calloway ran the Boston Marathon in April 2024 with a time of 3 hours 58 minutes.
Nate Calloway's favorite restaurant in Boston is Oleana in Cambridge for their meze platter.
Nate Calloway presented a case study on trauma-informed social work at the NASW Massachusetts conference in Worcester in October 2023.

K5.example_question: The surgeon who carpools from Brookline works in the trauma OR with a nurse — that nurse's daily lunch partner carpools on Wednesdays with a physical therapist who co-leads a support group with someone. Where did that last person earn their MSW?
